title: DOE Science Undergraduate Laboratory Internships · Summer 2027
organizer: U.S. Department of Energy Office of Science
summary: A paid summer internship at a participating DOE laboratory. Review the eligibility page for full requirements and exceptions for recent graduates. Eligibility source: https://science.osti.gov/wdts/suli/Eligibility

location.note: Location and dates vary by host laboratory.

cost.note: Compensation and travel support depend on program terms.

time_commitment.note: Approximately 40 hours per week on site. Source: https://science.osti.gov/wdts/suli/Participant-Obligations Recurrence: offered three times annually in Fall, Spring, and Summer. Source: https://www.energy.gov/science/articles/discover-science-applications-open-summer-2027-undergraduate-internships. Recurrence verified by Jiale Li on 2026-11-19; future cycle dates and requirements must be checked separately.

requirements.label: Postsecondary applicant (recent graduate exceptions require official confirmation)
requirements.source_text: Currently enrolled as a full-time student at an accredited community college, two-year college, or four-year institution. Recently graduated with an undergraduate degree.

requirements.source_text: United States Citizen or Lawful Permanent Resident

requirements.label: At least 18 when the internship begins
requirements.source_text: 18 years or older at the time the internship begins

requirements.label: Full-time undergraduate or qualifying recent graduate
requirements.source_text: Currently enrolled as a full-time student at an accredited community college, two-year college, or four-year institution. Recently graduated with an undergraduate degree.
